chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدٍ الْبَاقِرِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim and others from Abu Ja'far Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him), who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ خِيَارِ الْعِبَادِ قَالَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَحْسَنُوا اسْتَبْشَرُوا وَإِذَا أَسَاءُوا اسْتَغْفَرُوا وَإِذَا أُعْطُوا شَكَرُوا وَإِذَا ابْتُلُوا صَبَرُوا وَإِذَا غَضِبُوا غَفَرُوا

translations.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about the best of servants, so he said: 'They are those who, when they do good, rejoice; when they err, seek forgiveness; when they seek forgiveness; when they are given they show gratitude; when tested they are patient; and when angry they pardon.'

en.summary: In *Sifat al-Shifat al-Shia*, al-Saduq records this hadith to define the ethical character of the ideal believer, emphasizing that true piety is demonstrated through emotional regulation and consistent spiritual habits. This description aligns with the Shia understanding of the 'best servants' as those who embody the balance of hope and fear, reflecting the prophetic tradition of maintaining humility in prosperity and resilience in adversity.
en.seo_question: What are the characteristics of the best servants according to the Prophet?
